lines.text: Tucked between India and China sits one of the oldest countries on Earth: Nepal.
lines.say: Tucked between India and China sits one of the oldest countries on Earth: Nepal.
lines.caps: Tucked between India and China|sits one of the *oldest* countries|on Earth: *Nepal*.

lines.text: Legend says the Kathmandu Valley was once a lake, cut open by a sage's sword.
lines.say: Legend says the Kathmandu Valley was once a lake, cut open by a sage's sword.
lines.caps: Legend says the Kathmandu Valley|was once a *lake*|cut open by a sage's sword.

lines.text: Around 563 BC, the Buddha was born here, in the plains of Lumbini.
lines.say: Around five hundred and sixty-three B.C., the Buddha was born here, in the plains of Lumbini.
lines.caps: Around *563 BC*|the Buddha was born here|in the plains of Lumbini.

lines.text: For a thousand years, Licchavi and Malla kings carved cities of wood and brick.
lines.say: For a thousand years, Licchavi and Malla kings carved cities of wood and brick.
lines.caps: For a *thousand years*|Licchavi and Malla kings|carved cities of wood and brick.

lines.text: Then in 1743, a hill prince named Prithvi Narayan Shah set out to unite them all.
lines.say: Then in seventeen forty-three, a hill prince named Prithvi Narayan Shah set out to unite them all.
lines.caps: Then in *1743*|a hill prince named|*Prithvi Narayan Shah*|set out to|unite them all.

lines.text: By 1768, dozens of rival kingdoms had become a single country: Nepal.
lines.say: By seventeen sixty-eight, dozens of rival kingdoms had become a single country: Nepal.
lines.caps: By *1768*|dozens of rival kingdoms|had become a single country|*Nepal*.

lines.text: In 1814, the British attacked — but the Gurkhas fought so fiercely, Nepal was never colonized.
lines.say: In eighteen fourteen, the British attacked — but the Gurkhas fought so fiercely, Nepal was never colonized.
lines.caps: In *1814* the British attacked|but the *Gurkhas* fought so fiercely|Nepal was *never colonized*.

lines.text: Inside, the Rana family ruled for 104 years while kings watched from their palace.
lines.say: Inside, the Rana family ruled for one hundred and four years while kings watched from their palace.
lines.caps: Inside, the *Rana family*|ruled for *104 years*|while kings watched|from their palace.

lines.text: In 1953, climbers finally stood on the roof of the world — Everest, 8,849 metres.
lines.say: In nineteen fifty-three, climbers finally stood on the roof of the world — Everest, eight thousand eight hundred and forty-nine metres.
lines.caps: In *1953*, climbers finally stood|on the *roof of the world*|Everest, *8,849* metres.

lines.text: And in 2008, Nepal ended 240 years of monarchy and became a republic.
lines.say: And in two thousand and eight, Nepal ended two hundred and forty years of monarchy and became a republic.
lines.caps: And in *2008*,|Nepal ended *240 years* of monarchy|and became a *republic*.

lines.text: Never colonized. Always rebuilding. The story of Nepal.
lines.say: Never colonized. Always rebuilding. The story of Nepal.
